consolidated_findings.title: 16 vault refs without `| replace('$','$$')` in TOML/env/yaml (OK by design, but worth documenting)
consolidated_findings.evidence: their audit flagged 16 occurrences in non-compose files; my analysis: TOML/env/yaml are NOT interpolated by docker compose, so escape NOT needed. URL contexts use urlencode (safe). Their blanket grep vs my context-aware analysis differ
consolidated_findings.proposed_fix: add one-line comments in TOML/env/yaml template headers to make this explicit for future readers
